en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Ahmad, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Ahmad Bin Umar Al Hallal, from Yasir, from one of the slaves, 
From Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘If a servant does not stop from stealing even after he is satisfied with his wages, Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Exposes it against him’.
